phrases.latin: Benzīnum dēficit; ad statiōnem benzīnāriam cōnsistēmus.
phrases.english: We’re low on petrol; we’ll stop at the petrol station.

sources: Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. gasoline.
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency (printed page numbers): pp. 216, 320.
